title: The Telangana Vaccination Act, 1951.
full_text: The Telangana Vaccination Act, 1951. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195124 Act Number: 24 Enactment Date: 1951-07-05 Act Year: 1951 Short Title: The Telangana Vaccination Act, 1951. Long Title: An Act to provide for making the vaccination of unprotected children and unprotected persons compulsory. Department: Department of Health, Medical and Family Welfare Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Duties of guardian regarding vaccination of children. Section 4. Duty of an unprotected person to get himself vaccinated. Section 5. Duty of vaccinator to effect vaccination. Section 6. Duty of vaccinator to direct attendance for ascertaining results of vaccination. Section 7. Action to be taken when vaccination is successful or unsuccessful. Section 8. Certificate of unfitness for vaccination and its renewal. Section 9. Certificate of insusceptibility to successful vaccination. Section 10. Despatch of certificate of successful vaccination. Section 11. Cancellation of false or incorrect certificate. Section 12. No fee to be charged for vaccination done at a vaccination station. Section 13. Change of residence of unprotected persons or children. Section 14. Order for inspection of an unprotected child or person. Section 15. Delivery of or affixing a notice at the house of a guardian or person requiring a child or person to be vaccinated. Section 16. Penalty for not vaccinating a child within the age of six months. Section 17. Other penalties. Section 18. Penalty for false certificates. Section 19. Penalties for accepting illegal remuneration. Section 20. Cognizance of offences under this Act. Section 21. Rules. Section 22. Repeal.
